base.tech-mining-production.Name: Mining Production tons
base.tech-mining-production.Description: Annual production of accessibility 1.0 minerals for each mine or automated mine. Small amounts of lower accessibility minerals will be produced; half annual rate for 0.5 accesssibility, one tenth annual rate for 0.1 accessibility, etc.

base.tech-alcubierre-miniaturization.Name: Alcubierre Miniaturization
base.tech-alcubierre-miniaturization.Description: Research into shrinking a drive to fit smaller form factors

base.tech-alcubierre-bubble-creation-cos.Name: Alcubierre Bubble Creation Cost
base.tech-alcubierre-bubble-creation-cos.Description: By finding better ways to manipulate the warp bubble, we can make the drive more efficient

base.tech-alcubierre-sustain-cost.Name: Alcubierre Sustain Cost
base.tech-alcubierre-sustain-cost.Description: By finding better ways to manipulate the warp bubble, we can make the drive more efficient

base.tech-alcubierre-collapse-efficency.Name: Alcubierre Collapse Efficency
base.tech-alcubierre-collapse-efficency.Description: We can recover some of the energy put into creating the bubble when we collapse it in a controlled manner

base.tech-lox-max-size.Name: LOX / Hydrocarbon Maximum Size
base.tech-lox-max-size.Description: Research into better cooling allows larger engine sizes

base.tech-lox-exhaust-velocity.Name: LOX / Hydrocarbon Exhaust Velocity
base.tech-lox-exhaust-velocity.Description: Research into higher exhaust velocities for engines, making them more efficient

base.tech-lox-fuel-consumption.Name: LOX / Hydrocarbon Fuel Consumption
base.tech-lox-fuel-consumption.Description: Research into better plumbing and pump layouts allows higher fuel consumption for a given size

base.tech-jumppoint-stabilization.Name: JumpPoint Stabilization
base.tech-jumppoint-stabilization.Description: A ship equipped with this module can Stabilise a JumpPoint

base.tech-jumppoint-stabilization-size-r.Name: JumpPoint Stabilization Size Reduction
base.tech-jumppoint-stabilization-size-r.Description: Reduces the size of a component required for Jump Point Stabilisation

base.tech-jumppoint-stabilization-time-r.Name: JumpPoint Stabilization Time Reduction
base.tech-jumppoint-stabilization-time-r.Description: Reduces the time it takes to stabilise a Jump Point

base.tech-high-explosives.Name: High Explosives
base.tech-high-explosives.Description: Better explosive compounds increase the Relative effectiveness factor

base.tech-high-explosives-warheads.Name: HE Warheads
base.tech-high-explosives-warheads.Description: High Explosive Warheads that produce a large amount of heat and pressure

base.tech-fragmentation-warheads.Name: Fragmentation Warheads
base.tech-fragmentation-warheads.Description: Warheads that produce a large amount of fragmentation

base.tech-fission-warheads.Name: Fission Warheads
base.tech-fission-warheads.Description: Warheads that produce massive amounts of Heat and pressure

base.tech-laser-warheads.Name: Laser Warheads
base.tech-laser-warheads.Description: Smart warheads that fire a high energy beam towards the target on detonation

base.tech-triggers.Name: Trigger Tech
base.tech-triggers.Description: Enables different warhead triggers for ordnance

base.tech-antenna-sensitivity.Name: Antenna Sensitivity
base.tech-antenna-sensitivity.Description: Improvements to antennas to increase the ability to pick up smaller signals from background noise

base.tech-antenna-efficiency.Name: Antenna Efficiency
base.tech-antenna-efficiency.Description: Improvements to antennas increase the effective area of a sensor, allowing for greater sensitivity for a smaller size

base.tech-antenna-bandwidth.Name: Antenna Bandwidth
base.tech-antenna-bandwidth.Description: Improvements to antennas increase the max bandwidth of an antenna
